Quick update from infra/security side — drafted answers and populated the cache/autoscaling sections in the CSV. Highlights below (will put full text into the questionnaire worksheet):

- GPU support: A100 40GB and 80GB tested; H100 available on request (recommended for very high throughput/large KV footprints). We provide optimized kernels and quantization-friendly paths; quantization recommended where model quality allows (8-bit / 4-bit profiles).
- KV cache persistence: default in-memory KV per session; we support optional serialized snapshotting for dedicated deployments with TTL-based persistence (configurable). Eviction policy: LRU; typical warm cache hit-rate after steady traffic ~70-80% for repeated prefixes.
- Autoscaling/bursting: Dedicated pools support scheduled scaling + reactive scale based on queue depth; burst into pre-warmed nodes within same region (if reserved capacity includes burst allowance). Warm-up: cold-start to full throughput ~30-90s depending on model size and serialization; pre-warmed nodes near instantaneous.
- Limits and isolation: Dedicated pools are single-tenant; network isolation and KMS integration available. No cross-tenant KV leakage; audit logs for all requests.

I've added concrete throughput estimates in the CSV (tokens/sec per GPU for a 7B/13B/70B family at sequence lengths 128/512). Marissa, see the throughput table comments — I left the model latency multipliers for you to validate.

Dylan

Hi Olivia / ACME procurement team —

Thanks for the clear questionnaire. Please find our completed response attached (Redwood_RFP_Response_v1.pdf) and a capacity workbook with the sizing scenarios (capacity_calc_sheet.csv). Summary highlights:

- Recommended baseline (1M tokens/month): 2 x A100-40GB nodes, configured with batching and KV caching; expected steady-state throughput ~8500 tokens/sec aggregate; headroom for 15% sustained traffic growth.
- Recommended peak plan (5M tokens/month, spiky concurrency): 6 x A100-80GB or 4 x H100 nodes for lower latency & higher concurrent streams; estimated cold-warm transition handled by burst allowance; warm-up times noted in worksheet.
- Quantization: 4-bit quant profiles supported for 13B and 7B-class models (recommended where acceptable) to increase effective throughput ~1.7–2x with <3% median quality delta on our evals.
- Isolation & compliance: Dedicated pools are single-tenant with optional VPC peering, KMS integration, and audit logs (SOC2+ controls documented in the PDF).

Next steps:

- Please confirm whether ACME needs an itemized pricing estimate tied to the recommended reservation (I can have finance produce a draft by Monday).
